title: Rotated event-log archives are invisible to runtime history readers
description: Evidence: FileEventLog exposes readAllIncludingArchives, but FileBorealStore and ObjectDirBorealStore hydrate snapshots with live-only readAll; export/snapshot/ledger/operation paths then consume those store snapshots. Impact: after rotation, prior runtime events and operations disappear from operation list, doctor causality checks, exports, snapshots, ledgers, and migration snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Historical event/operation readers use archive-aware event-log reads where full history is required.
Tests rotate a log and still see pre-rotation history in operation list, export json, and export ledgers.
